name: Kit

intro.text: {player}. Cardiff Bay, no cameras. I switched them off. That should tell you something.
I've seen what the Enclosure actually does. The free merch was a lot less free than it looked.
I'm done with the sponsorship. But I'm not done with you. Let's go!

win: Right. Okay. That's fair. I'll go and be annoyingly right about things somewhere else.
after: I'm quitting the sponsorship, by the way. Mum says that's the most grown-up thing I've done. She said it with a face.
